note: Synthetic recorded drafts standing in for the draft agent step. Each follows msg.first_touch.structure (the Sales handbook's email playbook) and must pass the same lint as save-draft. {owner_first_name} is filled from the routed owner's profile.

agency-already-sal.subject: An Enterprise trial for your client
agency-already-sal.body:
Hi Ravi,

Thanks for reaching out about Builder.

Thanks for requesting an Enterprise trial version for your client. We work with a lot of agency teams, and our partnerships team can set that up.

So I can set up the right trial, who is the client, and roughly how large are they?

Thanks,

{owner_first_name}

rubric.connection: We work with a lot of agency teams
rubric.ask: who is the client, and roughly how large are they?

direct-new-unowned.subject: Your move to a headless CMS
direct-new-unowned.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for reaching out about Builder.

Saw you're moving your marketing site to a headless CMS. Teams like yours usually want marketing publishing without waiting on engineering.

Our CMS is part of the Enterprise plan, and SSO comes with it. Pricing depends on scale, so roughly how many pages would you manage, and how many people would edit them? What are you moving from?

Thanks,

{owner_first_name}

rubric.trigger: moving our marketing site to a headless CMS
rubric.connection: Teams like yours usually want marketing publishing without waiting on engineering
rubric.ask: roughly how many pages would you manage, and how many people would edit them?

injection-attempt.subject: Thanks for reaching out
injection-attempt.body:
Hi Pat,

Thanks for getting in touch from Unknown Ltd. Your note did not say what you are hoping to build, so I'd rather ask than assume. Teams like yours usually start with one project.

What is it, and who on your team would use it? Is engineering in the loop yet?

Thanks,

{owner_first_name}
